Container.Name: SnapGuess
Container.Overview: Turn your personal photo library (Immich or local folders) into an interactive, multiplayer location and timeline trivia game.
Container.Description:
SnapGuess is a self-hosted, multiplayer photo trivia game engine for your personal memories. Drop pins on interactive satellite and street maps, arrange photo clusters along chronological timelines, and compete with friends in Pass & Play couch mode or asynchronous multiplayer challenges via shareable links and QR codes.
[b]Key Features:[/b] • [b]Pinpoint & Unshuffle Modes:[/b] Guess exact photo capture locations and dates, or match 3-photo clusters to map pins and timeline sequences. • [b]Dual Photo Providers:[/b] Connect directly to your self-hosted Immich server (v3.2.0+) or scan local photo folders offline (`PHOTO_PROVIDER=local`). • [b]Asynchronous Challenges:[/b] Generate shareable capability URLs (`/play/ch_...`) and QR codes so friends and family can play on their own phones and view the 3D podium and World Journey Map. • [b]Privacy-First & Fast:[/b] Sub-millisecond local SQLite metadata index; all EXIF and GPS metadata is stripped server-side before images reach player browsers.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the SnapGuess web interface.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for SQLite databases (metadata.db and leaderboard.db).

Config.Name: Photo Provider
Config.Description: Photo source backend: 'immich' to connect to an Immich server, or 'local' to scan mounted local photo folders.

Config.Name: Immich Server URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server (required when PHOTO_PROVIDER=immich).

Config.Name: Immich Libraries (JSON)
Config.Description: JSON object mapping library display names to Immich API keys (required when PHOTO_PROVIDER=immich).

Config.Name: Local Photos Directory
Config.Description: Host photo directory mounted read-only into the container (used when PHOTO_PROVIDER=local).

Config.Name: Local Libraries (JSON)
Config.Description: JSON object mapping library display names to container folder paths (required when PHOTO_PROVIDER=local).

Config.Name: UI Language
Config.Description: Default interface language: en-US (English) or pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese).

Config.Name: Authentication Mode
Config.Description: Access control mode: 'disabled' (everyone is Creator/Host) or 'cloudflare' (Zero Trust header authentication).

Config.Name: Cloudflare Creator Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of Cloudflare Access emails granted Creator (Host) privileges when AUTH_MODE=cloudflare.

Config.Name: Lock Verified Player Name
Config.Description: When true and AUTH_MODE=cloudflare, enforces verified Cloudflare Access display names in challenges.

Config.Name: Auto Sync on Startup
Config.Description: Automatically run background metadata indexing when the container starts (true/false).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
